question:
In the given figure, ∠PSR = 105° and PQ is the diameter of the circle. What is the value (in degrees) of ∠QPR?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c04c94bd6f50e41d7ca9ae4f5c730e9a327fa86ac99d4f4de481af6e7071000d.png]
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1ed42c23bdd577c6fd75fbea3ce93404f89eee460e1dff7cdc5ed3522269d25e.png] 

∠PSR = 105°

So, angle ∠RQP = 75°

PQ is diameter so angle PRQ = 90°

∠RPQ = 180 − (90 + 75)

∠RPQ = 15°
